title: The Fourth, 2007
logline: White fireworks. A tourist on the dock in the stick-figure shirt. Gully pours him a coffee like anyone. Wood watches Gully do it.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. A TOURIST in the stick-figure t-shirt in the coffee line. GULLY pouring. WOOD on the steps.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks, a tourist in a t-shirt printed with a crude stick figure waiting in a coffee line, a man in an apron pouring, a thin man on shack steps with a dog, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: Gully handing him the cup. Looking at the shirt. Looking at Wood on the steps. Handing him the cup.

characters.pose: handing a cup, glancing at the shirt

balloons.text: Is the guy who— is he here?

image.prompt: a man in an apron handing a paper cup to a tourist in a stick-figure shirt while glancing at the shirt, then away

panels.composition: Wood on the steps, drawing the tourist. The shirt, in the drawing, blank again.
props: pad: a tourist with a blank shirt

image.prompt: a thin man on shack steps drawing a tourist whose printed t-shirt he leaves blank on the page

panels.composition: The finale. White. The chair, empty. The tourist, the shirt, the crowd, Gully, Wood, the dog. Everyone gets the fireworks.

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue night bay above a crowded dock with an empty lawn chair under a shack's eave, watercolor, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm
